type Bound = Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>;

/** Split params into [picked, rest] by key. */
function split(params: object | undefined, keys: readonly string[]): [Record<string, unknown>, Record<string, unknown>] {
  const picked: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const rest: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params ?? {})) (keys.includes(k) ? picked : rest)[k] = v;
  return [picked, rest];
}

/** Fill `actor_id` from a scope bound with `.as(actorId)`, unless the call passes one. */
function fillActor<P>(params: P, bound: Bound): P {
  if (bound.actor_id === undefined) return params;
  const p = (params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  return (p.actor_id === undefined ? { ...p, actor_id: bound.actor_id } : p) as P;
}

  protected readonly _b: Bound;
  constructor(client: APIClient, bound: Bound = {}) {
    this._client = client;
    this._b = bound;
  }
}

   * const post = await fixture.community("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").posts.create({ body: "Hello" });
   * ```
   */
  create(params: T.WithOptionalActor<T.PostCreateParams>, options?: RequestOptions): APIPromise<T.WithLastResponse<T.Post>> {
    return this._client.request({ method: "POST", path: "/v1/communities/{community_id}/posts", pathParams: { community_id: this._b.community_id }, body: fillActor(params, this._b), idempotent: true }, options);
  }
  /**
   * List posts
   *
   * @param params - `Fixture.PostListParams`.
   * @param options - Per-request options.
   * @see GET /v1/communities/{community_id}/posts
   * @see https://productcraft.co/docs/fixture/api-reference#get-v1-communities-community-id-posts
   * @example
   * ```ts
   * for await (const post of fixture.community("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").posts.list()) {
   *   console.log(post);
   * }
   * const page = await fixture.community("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").posts.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
   * ```
   */
  list(params?: T.WithOptionalActor<T.PostListParams>, options?: RequestOptions): PagePromise<T.Post> {
    return this._client.list({ method: "GET", path: "/v1/communities/{community_id}/posts", pathParams: { community_id: this._b.community_id }, query: fillActor(params, this._b) }, options);
  }
}

/** `fixture.community(…)`: Calls scoped to one community. Chain `.as(actorId)` to act as a user. */
export class FixtureCommunity extends APIResource {
  #posts?: CommunityPostsResource;
  /**
   * A copy of this scope that fills `actor_id` in every body or query that declares it, unless the call passes one.
   * @param actorId - The acting user.
   */
  as(actorId: string): FixtureCommunity {
    return new FixtureCommunity(this._client, { ...this._b, actor_id: actorId });
  }
  get posts(): CommunityPostsResource {
    return (this.#posts ??= new CommunityPostsResource(this._client, this._b));
  }
}

/** `entries` */
export class PublicEntriesResource extends APIResource {
  /**
   * Join a waitlist
   *
   * Keyless and browser-safe.
   *
   * @param params - `Fixture.EntryCreateParams`.
   * @param options - Per-request options.
   * @throws {BadRequestError} 400 BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_ERROR: Validation failed.
   * @throws {RateLimitError} 429 RATE_LIMITED: Rate limited; see Retry-After.
   * @see POST /v1/public/{workspace_slug}/{waitlist_slug}/entries
   * @see https://productcraft.co/docs/fixture/api-reference#post-v1-public-workspace-slug-waitlist-slug-entries
   * @example
   * ```ts
   * const entry = await fixture.public({ workspace: "acme", waitlist: "beta" }).entries.create({ email: "ada@example.com" });
   * ```
   */
  create(params: T.EntryCreateParams, options?: RequestOptions): APIPromise<T.WithLastResponse<T.Entry>> {
    return this._client.request({ method: "POST", path: "/v1/public/{workspace_slug}/{waitlist_slug}/entries", pathParams: { workspace_slug: this._b.workspace_slug, waitlist_slug: this._b.waitlist_slug }, body: params, public: true }, options);
  }
}

/** `fixture.public(…)`: Keyless, browser-safe calls for one public waitlist. */
export class FixturePublic extends APIResource {
  #entries?: PublicEntriesResource;
  get entries(): PublicEntriesResource {
    return (this.#entries ??= new PublicEntriesResource(this._client, this._b));
  }
}
